name: Ichiyanagi Yumihiko
source:
Eustace Winner is a young rookie prosecutor who was assigned to take over a number of [url=https://vndb.org/c10833]Miles Edgeworth[/url]'s cases by the Committee for Prosecutorial Excellence. Despite graduating at the top of his class and receiving many awards during his legal studies, leading him to becoming a prosecutor by the age of 17, he was barely competent and had terrible logic; it would often fall to judge and Committee member [url=https://vndb.org/c19273]Verity Gavèlle[/url], who acted as his assistant, to argue Edgeworth's logic. 

[spoiler]All of his accolades were not actually earned; simply being given due to the influence of his father, [url=https://vndb.org/c19567]Excelsius Winner[/url]. When Eustace found out the truth, he was initially devastated, but eventually resolved to overcome his corrupt father and improve himself as a prosecutor.[/spoiler]

[From https://aceattorney.fandom.com/wiki/Eustace_Winner]
